items.label: H.R. 4016

latest_action.text: Motion to proceed to consideration of measure made in Senate. (CR S8522)

items.summary: H.R. 4016 provides fiscal year 2026 appropriations for military activities of the Department of Defense, excluding military construction, family housing, Army Corps of Engineers civil works, and nuclear warheads. It sets funding for personnel, operation and maintenance, procurement, research and development, and revolving funds, while establishing strict administrative rules, restrictions, and reporting requirements.
items.title: Department of Defense Appropriations Act, 2026

items.label: H.R. 5304

latest_action.text: Placed on the Union Calendar, Calendar No. 227.

items.summary: H.R. 5304 provides federal fiscal year 2026 appropriations and sets policy requirements for the Departments of Labor, Health and Human Services, and Education, as well as several related agencies. The legislation allocates funding for employment training, public health research and programs, elementary and secondary education, higher education student assistance, and various social support programs while also restricting funds for specific administrative rules, executive orders, and organizational grants.
items.title: Departments of Labor, Health and Human Services, and Education, and Related Agencies Appropriations Act, 2026

items.label: S. 2572

latest_action.text: Placed on Senate Legislative Calendar under General Orders. Calendar No. 137.

items.summary: This bill provides fiscal year 2026 appropriations for military activities of the Department of Defense, including personnel, operation and maintenance, procurement, research and development, and related intelligence and health programs, while setting rules and restrictions on the use and transfer of these funds.
items.title: Department of Defense Appropriations Act, 2026

items.label: H.R. 8800
items.summary: H.R. 8800 sets national defense authorizations for Fiscal Year 2027, addressing military personnel, benefits, health care, acquisition policies, military construction projects, Department of Energy national security programs, and maritime administration activities. It also includes the 'SAVE America Act', which alters federal election voting requirements.
items.title: National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2027

items.label: H.R. 9495

latest_action.text: Placed on the Union Calendar, Calendar No. 621.

items.summary: H.R. 9495 provides fiscal year 2027 appropriations for the Department of Defense and related military activities, excluding military construction, family housing, Army Corps of Engineers civil works, and nuclear warheads. It sets funding levels for military personnel, operation and maintenance, procurement, research and development, revolving funds, and specific defense programs. Additionally, the bill includes administrative requirements, restrictions, and policy provisions governing defense funds, contracting, and intelligence activities.
items.title: Department of Defense Appropriations Act, 2027

items.label: S. 2587

latest_action.text: Placed on Senate Legislative Calendar under General Orders. Calendar No. 140.

items.summary: S. 2587 provides fiscal year 2026 appropriations for the Departments of Labor, Health and Human Services (HHS), and Education, and related agencies. It sets spending levels and includes specific requirements, restrictions, and policy provisions for various federal programs administered by these departments.
items.title: Departments of Labor, Health and Human Services, and Education, and Related Agencies Appropriations Act, 2026
